system.description: Your tactical mind and directions can spur your allies to victory. Choose one of the following combat disciplines: Attack, Damage, or Evade, and then make an Unopposed Skill Check. On Success, you and each member of your party gain a +1 bonus to Checks for the chosen discipline. Increase the bonus by +1 for each higher degree of Success.

upgrades.description: If you observe the foes and battlefield for at least 5 minutes prior to combat, roll this Skill Check with Advantage.
After using this Skill during a combat, you roll 2d10 when you Call a Play (still choose one die).
The bonus applies to all three combat disciplines instead of just one.

system.limitations: A crawler may attempt this Skill Check only once per combat.
